description: Known-ODE and GNN parameter and prediction recovery on FlyWire hybrid connectomes (e8 hybrid, 13,741 neurons; FlyWire eye, 50,412 neurons) under null-edge augmentation, model noise sigma = 0.05, 5-fold cross-validation. Rows condl25_cv00-04 train the general-form GNN with g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j) under a group lasso of 25; rows kode_cv00-04 train the Known-ODE model with learned W, tau, V_rest. Prediction metrics computed on noise-free held-out stimuli, 7,207-7,999 frames per fold. Parameter recovery reports R2 for W over fitted non-zero edges, and R2 for tau and V_rest over all neurons, outlier-corrected; MLP and EED rows are published baseline values.
facts:
CAPTION: GNN recovery on hybrid connectome variants under connectivity uncertainty (null-edge augmentation); low model noise σ = 0.05, 5-fold CV (mean ± SD). Variant is either e8 hybrid (13,741 neurons) or FlyWire eye (50,412 neurons). Known-ODE and GNN rows are the campaign’s re-runs (experiment 7, runs <variant>_blank50_kode_cv0N and <variant>_blank50_condl25_cv0N): the GNN is the general-form GNN, gϕ = MLP(ai, aj, vi, vj) under a group lasso of 25; ML baselines are the published controls. Prediction metrics on noise-free held-out stimuli (7,207–7,999 frames by fold for the GNN and Known-ODE rows). Parameter recovery: R2 c W by the template readout over the fitted non-zero edges; R2 bτ and R2 bV rest over all neurons, outlier-corrected (Appendix I). Green: > 0.9.
FACTS:
- Known ODE: experiment 7: FlyWire hybrids: Known ODE and GNN
- GNN: experiment 7: FlyWire hybrids: Known ODE and GNN
- MLP and EED (published): published values
GLOSSARY (meaning of identifier fragments; use only these):
- blank50: in every video clip of the stimulus, the first 50% of the frames are replaced by blank frames
- cv00 .. cv04: cross-validation folds 0 to 4
- noise_free / noise_005 / noise_05: model noise sigma 0 / 0.05 / 0.5
- 010 / 020 after noise_005: measurement noise gamma 0.1 / 0.2
- flyvis_conductance: code name of the general-form GNN, g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)
- flyvis_known_ode: code name of the Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned W, tau, V_rest)
- condl25 / condl100: group lasso 25 / 100 on g_phi's input groups
- null_edges_pc_400 / null400: 400% extra null edges added to the connectome
- removed_pc_20 / rm20, removed_pc_50 / rm50: 20% / 50% of the edges removed
- hidden_020 / hid20, hid10: 20% / 10% of the neurons hidden
- s5h06 / s5h21: one frame in five observed, rollout horizon 6 / 21
- INR_davis: stimulus not given, learned by a SIREN network
- full_eye_flywireRF / e8_flywireRF: FlyWire eye / e8 hybrid connectome; proximal_nulls: with proximal null edges
